appendDesc.Sorting and Collections: Also covers the open hash map and set, size tracking collections used by the shuffle and aggregation buffers, the pair buffer, the primitive vector, the percentile heap, and the Sorter wrapper over TimSort with its SortDataFormat.
appendDesc.Core Utilities: Also covers chunked byte buffers, rolling log appenders and the driver log, random samplers (Bernoulli, Poisson, stratified sampling), the XORShift random generator, SparkPath and the SparkCoreErrors factory.

tour.title: Sampling: RandomSampler and XORShiftRandom
tour.description: RandomSampler is the trait behind sample, with Bernoulli and Poisson samplers that draw from a seeded generator. XORShiftRandom is the fast Random replacement they use, and StratifiedSamplingUtils computes per-key acceptance thresholds for sampleByKey.
